subject: Agriculture
title: The GMO Debate
description: Learn The GMO Debate in one minute.

hook.text: Over 90% of US corn and soybeans are genetically modified. Most Americans eat GMOs daily without knowing it.

buildup.text: GMOs have genes from other species inserted to add traits—insect resistance, herbicide tolerance, drought survival.

discovery.text: Bt corn carries a bacterial gene that produces its own insecticide. The plant kills the pest—no spraying needed.

twist.text: Over 2,000 studies confirm GMO safety for human consumption. Yet public opposition remains fierce in Europe and Africa.

climax.text: The real concerns are corporate control of seeds, herbicide-resistant superweeds, and biodiversity loss—not food safety.

punchline.text: The science says safe. The debate isn't about science—it's about power.
